narrative.intro: At and T Enterprises obligated $164M in FY2027 to date. At and T Enterprises received 4 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $41.1M, and obligations are down 84.1% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations have varied: FY22 was $349M, FY23 was $778M, FY24 was $941M, FY25 was $1B, and FY26 was $1B. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). The Department of Veterans Affairs is the top buying agency for FY2027 to date, obligating $164M. The General Services Administration and the Department of Defense show $0 in obligations to At and T Enterprises for the same period. This profile shows a steep decline in obligations in the current fiscal year compared with prior full fiscal years, concentrated in a single buying agency so far.
